contract:
Desktop campus home, first pass: campus identity, labels, map halos, tour and post edit. No org follow/invite UI, which is the B19-orgs runs below. This batch is the sole owner of campus-home.tsx for its run.

1. Viewer campus source
- Add an exported hook `useViewerCampus()` inside campus-home.tsx, next to CampusBanner (:3325). It fetches GET /api/campuses once per page (module-level promise cache, credentials include) and returns {system, campusId, campus: Campus|null (campusRowById), label: string|null}.
- label = campus.name: 'Indianapolis', 'IU Bloomington', 'Purdue West Lafayette'. Never 'IUI' / 'PUI' / 'Jaguars'.
- Failure or null means label null. Never fall back to 'IU'.

2. SCHOOL constant (:290-296)
- Delete it. CampusBanner (:3325-3450) renders from useViewerCampus.
- Title = label ?? 'Vibe'.
- Monogram = initials of campus.shortName (one word → first two letters, 'IN'; several words → initials, 'FW', 'WL').
- Background (:3396-3398): IU crimson ONLY when campus.systems is ['iu']; a neutral Vibe ink gradient for a shared campus or no campus (plan §2.5: 'The shared banner uses a neutral colour, not IU crimson'); Purdue-only campuses get a black/gold gradient.
- Shared campus: a sub-label '{SYSTEM_LABEL[system]} + {other} · one community' next to the stats line, e.g. 'IU + Purdue'.
- IMPORTANT: CampusBanner is also rendered on the phone by CampusMobile.tsx:426 (compactSearch). Keep the compact layout at 375px and ellipsize long names.

3. Stats line (:3337-3383, :3446-3449)
- Read campusUsers / campusActiveNow. Label '{n} at {label}' and '{m} active now'.
- When campusUsers is null (no campus), fall back to today's '{totalUsers} on Vibe'.
- On a read error, render nothing instead of 'loading…' forever.

4. Campus-less prompt (plan critic A8)
- When system is non-null and campusId is null, show a slim strip under CampusBanner in CampusHome (:681), not inside CampusBanner, so the phone is unaffected unless B14 opts in.
- Copy: 'Pick your campus to see its clubs, events and map.' with a link 'Pick campus →' to /settings#campus.
- Do not build a 'Confirm your campus' prompt here (Settings B15 owns that; /api/campuses has no campusConfirmed).

5. Labels
- Eyebrows :4523 'Feed · IU', :7028 'Events · IU', :8255 'Organizations · IU', :9784 'Campus · IU', :13517 'Campus · IU' become '{Tab} · {label}', or just '{Tab}' when label is null.
- :8257 subtitle becomes 'Browse clubs and orgs at {label}.' (or 'Browse clubs and orgs.'). Drop the stale 'Public ones you can join instantly, private ones you can request.'; B19-orgs sets the final follow/join sentence.
- :8375 hint becomes 'Officially recognized clubs at {label}.'
- :13590-13591 becomes 'Browse clubs and orgs at {label}.'
- :9847 map empty copy 'Nothing here is verified — you can change it any time.' becomes 'The map groups people by major at your campus. Pick yours in Settings.'
- Feed empty :4603-4604 may keep 'people from your school', or change it to 'people at {label}'.

6. Map halos (plan critic C8)
- Import PURDUE_INDIANAPOLIS_SCHOOLS and schoolForMajorIn. Define `const HALO_SCHOOLS = [...IU_SCHOOLS, ...PURDUE_INDIANAPOLIS_SCHOOLS]` in-file (no edit to majors.ts).
- Replace schoolForMajor(m.name) with schoolForMajorIn(data.campus_id ?? null, null, m.name) at :9518, :10056 and :10536. System null is intended: a bubble aggregates both universities; IU is tried first, then Purdue (majors.ts:377-400).
- Replace IU_SCHOOLS.filter/map/find with HALO_SCHOOLS at :9525, :10304 and :10349.
- MapSummary type (:9394-9404) gains campus_id?: string|null.

7. Tour (plan critic C7; phone B14 sets HANDOFFS.campus.next = null)
- In the desktop tour (:381-455), the step body at :423 'Live posts from your school…' becomes 'What students at {label ?? "your campus"} are posting. People you follow rise to the top.'
- The last step's endLabel 'Take me to network →' (:427) becomes 'Got it'.
- onDone (:437-445) sets seenKey, removes vibe_tour_pending, strips the param, and does NOT navigate to /network?welcome=1.

8. page.tsx:7
- description becomes 'Your campus on Vibe: clubs, events, people and the map.'

9. Post edit (Franky 2026-09-15, desktop feed) in FeedRow (:5136)
- Add a menuitem 'Edit post' above 'Delete post' in the owner block (:5475-5495), shown only when viewerOwnsPost (:5154).
- It swaps the content block (:5640-5661) for a textarea prefilled with post.content: maxLength 2000 (MAX_CONTENT_CHARS, posts/[id]/route.ts:18), a live counter, buttons 'Save' / 'Cancel', Esc cancels.
- Save: vibeRequest(`/api/posts/${post.id}`, {method:'PATCH', json:{content}, failure:"Couldn't save your edit."}).
  - On ok, update the local content from r.data.post.content and call onMutate().
  - On failure, keep the editor open with the text intact.
- Disable Save when unchanged, or when the trimmed content is empty and the post has no media (the server accepts ''; the client must not blank a text post).
- Caption only: never send tags or status. Do not show an 'edited' marker: no column records it.
- Repost entries: Edit targets the original post only when the viewer owns it; the repost quote is not editable.

10. Optional interim fix for a live dead button
- DiscoverCard label (:9103-9111) and OrgQuickViewModal ctaLabel (:8447-8454) prefer the discover row's join_state when present:
  - invite_only → disabled 'Invite only';
  - requested → 'Requested';
  - member → 'Joined';
  - audience_blocked → disabled 'IU students only' / 'Purdue students only';
  - otherwise today's is_public logic.
- Today every non-member of SAE (invite-only, the only visible club) gets 'Request to join' → 403 invite_only. Add `join_state?: string` to DiscoverOrg (:8124-8140). No other org edits.
